messages.author: 6b0dfe652c192bfb
messages.subject: Shiny and responsive design?
parts:
Hi,

I need to create an app and think that Shiny might be the way to do it. I use R a lot, but have not used shiny before. I also want to make it work well on different browsers, and am starting to read up about responsive design (where the page adapts according to the device being used to view the page, e.g. http://designmodo.com/responsive-design-examples/). I think that ideally I would like to have a shiny app that is built using a responsive design approach/principles and was wondering anyone has any examples of having tried this they could point me to.

Thanks.

David

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: Shiny and responsive design?
parts:
Hi David,
Shiny leverages Bootstrap for the UI front end and Bootstrap's layouts take responsive design into consideration.  Many of the apps that you see people building with Shiny are usable on a tablet device and some even work out of the box on smart phones.  
HTH
